review_independence_note: Role-separated passes shared one orchestration context and are not claimed as independent or mutually blind review.

implementation.algorithm: mandatory-set placement followed by deterministic marginal weighted coverage per token over fiber-relevant optional items
implementation.authority_boundary: does not retrieve payloads, summarize evidence, mutate memory, route tools, activate model behavior or mint scientific authority

intermediate_validation.note: Intermediate code/API authority. Research/docs/receipt commits were added later, so final exact-SHA candidate CI remains mandatory before promotion.

saturation.reason: Eight non-duplicate architecture/method objects survived deduplication and five high-impact engineering child fibers were opened.

promotion.rule: Recheck exact candidate CI, protected inputs, ahead-only ancestry and unchanged current main before non-forced fast-forward.

next_ai.positive: After promotion, freeze real matched context-policy tasks before integrating the compiler into router/model invocation; then implement reconstructable multi-resolution memory.
next_ai.null: If recency/top-k/summary-only baselines match epistemic integrity and downstream quality at lower cost, preserve the null and keep context_compiler optional rather than mandatory.
next_ai.refuted: If a known-answer task requires information the coverage/mandatory contract systematically omits, preserve the counterexample and revise the contract under a new frozen benchmark rather than weakening the old one post hoc.
next_ai.partial_id: If the compiler can guarantee mandatory epistemic recall but not downstream result parity for some operations, keep support authorization local to those guarantees.
next_ai.blocked: If required coverage cannot fit the model/profile budget, return CANNOT_COMPILE and decompose/rebudget; do not silently truncate.
next_ai.transport: If main moves during final validation, rebuild on current main while preserving the frozen Round-020 benchmark and negative history.
